evidence: 26 GPP NetCDF means cover 1859-1899 and 2259-2299 for 13 ESMs and explicitly identify GPP in kg m-2 y-1. Nine accompanying point shapefiles identify candidate dieback cells. Annual grids and tabular GPP support the calculation. First four records in each of 12 models verified that mean19th/mean23rd in filtered2-npp.xlsx equal corresponding GPP mean-grid values; matching numeric values occur in the _change.xlsx family.
limitations: The nine shapefiles contain points with FID only, not polygon areas or a loss field. Sampling all 292 points against their paired GPP means found 292 future/past ratios below 0.30 but only 234 below 0.20; therefore they do not all satisfy the spreadsheet definition of over 80% decrease. The 24 summary tables have misleading npp filenames, require a coordinate/ID join, and _change IDs were one lower in the inspected pairs. Grids are global, not already clipped to the Amazon. Other periods, climate/NPP means, Koppen classes and regional summaries are separate outputs without matching dataset descriptions. Variable time bounds, inherited historical metadata, calendars and model-specific licensing still need validation before catalog publication.

evidence: Forty-eight CropYield CSVs plus 16 workbooks and 48 TotalCropYield CSVs plus 16 workbooks provide annual scenario crop yield and complementary total-production aggregates. All CSVs were checked for coverage: 2000-2014 historical and 2019-2099 future. Sample workbooks contain historical/ssp126/ssp585 sheets with the same model/downscaling columns. Landuse_analysis_library.R extracts SWAT HRU YLD, aggregates potato classes over selected Chaglla subbasins and exports annual results.
limitations: The sheet period 1985-2014 is only partly delivered and future summaries stop in 2099, not 2100. The code includes POTA plus half-weighted POSE production; confirm agronomic meaning and reporting units. Both KNN and BCSD are present. XLSX/CSV formats overlap and should not be counted as independent datasets. These files do not deliver HRU-specific daily values.
